At ₹80,000 aim for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB SSD and a recent mid-range processor (Ryzen 5/7 or Core i5/i7, or an Apple chip if the budget stretches). Memory matters most for programming. Avoid 8 GB, since it fills up fast with a browser, editor and a few apps open.

Next, look at the keyboard, the screen (full HD or better, at least 14 inches) and battery life. Skip a gaming graphics card unless you'll train AI or do game work, because it adds weight and cuts battery life.

One thing changes the shortlist: do you need Windows, Mac or Linux? Tell me that and what you build (web, apps, data work), and I can look up current options and compare them. Nothing gets bought.
